def taxi_fare_cents(base_cents, per_km_cents, km):
    """Compute the total cost, in cents, of a taxi journey billed under a
    fixed-rate tariff. The tariff consists of a flat pickup charge together
    with a constant charge applied for each kilometre travelled. All three
    arguments are ints with base_cents >= 0, per_km_cents >= 0, km >= 0.
    Because every quantity is expressed in integer cents, the computation
    involves no rounding and no floating-point arithmetic at any point.
    Return the total fare in cents: base_cents + per_km_cents * km exactly.
    In particular, when the distance travelled is zero kilometres, the fare
    reduces to the pickup charge alone.

    >>> taxi_fare_cents(250, 0, 0)
    250
    >>> taxi_fare_cents(250, 120, 7)
    1090
    """
